title: Look What the Probes Dragged In! Real-World Chest X-ray Shortcuts in MedCLIP
abstract: arXiv:2608.12086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models, such as contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP)-based approaches, have reached state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in medical artificial intelligence. However, recent work reveals that CLIP-based models remain vulnerable to shortcuts. We investigate how real-world shortcuts manifest across different layers of the medical CLIP-based model, MedCLIP, and its vision encoder, a frozen ResNet-50. We attach 17 linear classification probes to the intermediate layers of the ResNet-50 and train them on three different dataset configurations and targets: NIH-CXR14 (pneumothorax) and PadChest (cardiomegaly and pneumothorax). This setup allows us to observe model behaviour during evaluation using subgroup-based calibration and layer-wise confidence curves. We find that the final linear probes achieve a high AUROC but poor calibration in the models. The layer-wise confidence analyses suggest that shortcuts emerge at differ

translated_title: 看看探针拖进来了什么！MedCLIP中真实世界胸部X光捷径的研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12086v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：视觉语言模型，如基于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）的方法，已在医学人工智能领域达到最先进（SOTA）水平。然而，近期研究揭示，基于CLIP的模型仍易受捷径（shortcuts）影响。我们研究了真实世界捷径如何在医学CLIP模型MedCLIP及其视觉编码器（冻结的ResNet-50）的不同层中显现。我们向ResNet-50的中间层附加了17个线性分类探针，并在三种不同的数据集配置和目标上训练它们：NIH-CXR14（气胸）和PadChest（心脏肥大和气胸）。这一设置使我们能够在评估过程中，通过基于子组的校准和逐层置信度曲线观察模型行为。我们发现，最终线性探针在模型中实现了高AUROC，但校准不佳。逐层置信度分析表明，捷径在不同层中出现。
tldr: 本研究通过线性探针分析揭示了MedCLIP模型中真实世界捷径在不同网络层的表现，发现最终层虽准确率高但校准差，且捷径在不同层中差异化出现。
en_tdlr: This study reveals how real-world shortcuts manifest across layers in MedCLIP using linear probes, finding high AUROC but poor calibration in final layers, with shortcuts emerging at different depths.
